title: Learning reshapes the hippocampal representation hierarchy
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Figure 4D binary context decoding conditional on actual position from speed-equalized CA1 population vectors, preserving the source learning-session support and comparison to its conditional decoder. It is an original paper endpoint; changes in hierarchy depth or curve fidelity are not decoding improvement.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Figure 4D binary context decoding conditional on actual position from speed-equalized CA1 population vectors, preserving the source learning-session support and comparison to its conditional decoder. It is an original paper endpoint; changes in hierarchy depth or curve fidelity are not decoding improvement.

Source-paper comparison for Figure 4D conditional context-decoding performance, pending source accuracy/error reconciliation: Paper Figure 4/Methods describe a normalized absolute label difference while calling it accuracy; code uses exact-match accuracy_score in the global route. For binary context, accuracy and one-minus-normalized-error can coincide, but the source scoring transformation must be explicitly reconciled and the conditional zero-return array cannot be used as a score.
success_criteria: Recover exact Figure 4D numeric score, metric transformation and original aggregation.

Bind the source speed-equalized inputs, all 25 sessions, decoder configuration and original 100-repeat stratified 70/30 plus within-partition-bootstrap protocol. Recovered or regenerated draws are admissible when candidate and author share them and seed/environment provenance plus a justified calibration tolerance are declared in advance.
Resolve the author conditional-score output defect by independently verifying prediction-derived scoring, without treating zeros as the baseline to beat.
Freeze candidate and comparison rules before final evaluation; show meaningful performance gain under valid uncertainty on the identical original endpoint.
Keep hierarchy-curve reconstruction, alternate clustering, larger context separation and new held-animal/day/trial decoding as calibration or extensions, not paper wins.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
